primary.description: Neon Cyan — primary brand accent for active states, primary actions, and key highlights.

primary_light.description: Mint Teal — hover state and muted accent variant of the primary brand color.

secondary.description: Electric Violet — platform's unique secondary brand accent. Used in gradients, secondary highlights, and brand differentiators.

secondary_light.description: Soft Violet — hover state of the Electric Violet brand secondary.

brand_gradient.description: Core brand gradient from Neon Cyan to Electric Violet. Used in logos, primary buttons, section highlights, and stat values.

accent.description: Emerald Green — success, paid states, approved balances, and growth graphs.

warning.description: Amber — pending payouts, holding balances, and warning badges.

danger.description: Rose — delete actions, rejections, suspensions, and error states.

background.description: Deep Space — base canvas background of the platform.

surface.description: Cosmic Slate — elevated card/container surface background.

surface_nested.description: Deep Navy — nested modals, table headers, and inner panels.

sidebar.description: Void Black — sidebar navigation background for maximum contrast hierarchy.

header.description: Translucent Deep Space header with backdrop blur.

border.description: Cyan-tinted subtle border for cards, grids, and layout dividers.

border_strong.description: Violet-tinted active border for hover states and highlighted components.

animations.glowDrift: 18s ease-in-out infinite — organic drifting of background glow orbs
animations.livePulse: 2s ease-in-out infinite — neon pulse for live activity indicators
animations.dashFloat: 6s ease-in-out infinite — 3D floating perspective for dashboard hero cards
animations.wordIn: 0.6s ease-out — word-by-word entrance for hero headings
